scope: Consumer verification of the first-run evidence review rebuilt for D100: the declined state as an open but unreadable library, and no state without a source (D95). It verifies this page and its checks, not source recovery, production behaviour or native accessibility.
supersedes: The record of the rebuild after D84 (32 views, four states), whose declined state asked to choose a folder and whose fourth state had no source open.
noDigests: This record holds no digest of the page, template, builder, test, manifest or any report. Nothing is locked by hash (D88); later edits to those files are allowed and are not covered by this record.

build.result: Built offline first-run state evidence with 28 inspected native views, 4 of them end views. Validated offline first-run review, optional observations and the absence of the withdrawn analysis choice.

consumerTest.result: First-run review consumer: positive, 14 rejected manifests, a synthetic end view, ballot, withdrawn-sentence, 4 rejected pages and changed-output checks passed.

browser.limits: Every embedded view was opened once in the first context; controls, observations, drag status and one modal were exercised in all four contexts. Axe audits are of the closed page only, not native acceptance. Firefox and an open-dialog accessibility audit were not run.

visualInspection: All 28 published views were read in full as light and dark pairs before publication: authored content only, no status strip, dialog or notice, and a gesture handle in every view. At 200% text the declined state scrolls on both panels and its end view is kept; the no-audio states do not scroll.
